explanation: This fires only at the GO step, right after a trial that reached S2 and was rewarded, whichever action got there (it reads "S2 just paid off", including a1 that went rare to S2). How high depends on time in the episode: about 1-4 before trial 70, about 6-10 from trial 80 on, and it is 0 at D1 and D2 and after any trial that was unrewarded or reached S1.
